title: USEFUL, but a bit big
text: USEFUL, but a bit big. A little surprised at the larger size, but it does do the trick for storing and catching drips from the toilet bowl swab.

product_metadata.title: Fuller Brush Toilet Bowl Brush Holder - Modern & Stylish Bathroom Scrub Drying Rack - Decorative Cleaner Case for Clean & Organized Home & Business Restroom
features: ATTRACTIVELY DESIGNED: Keep your toilet brush conveniently stored between cleanings with a Fuller Brush Toilet Bowl Holder. Attractively designed and furnished in an easy-to-incorporate white color, it discreetly conceals the brush when not in use.
EFFICIENT DESIGN: The Brush Holder is designed with an open back to allow for adequate air circulation. As a result, it speeds up the drying process of the bush.

PROTECTS FLOOR: Without a holder, your brush will drip and leave water stains on your floor! Do you really want to clean up water that dripped off the toilet brush and onto the floor once the dripping has stopped?

COMPATIBLE HOLDER: Use the Fuller Brush Holder to house your toilet bowl brush in between uses. It’s a perfect fit for the Fuller Brush Bent-Tip Bowl Brush and can also be used for the Ultimate Bowl Brush.

TRUSTED BRAND: Since 1906, Fuller Brush has provided high-quality, American-Made products that are designed to work and built to last. Whether you're looking for cleaning tips or the specific cleaning products to do the job, Fuller Brush has you covered!
